objective: Owner, 2026-11-07: fix the HUD icons, make the weekly and monthly login trackers pop, and show no name bar on unnamed creatures.
inputs: docs/game-design/game4-gdd.md sections X1, X3.5 and V5
acceptance_criteria: Strip icons show their image with no fallback glyph behind it once loaded, and no strip label spills past its button

The weekly and monthly tabs open with a coloured banner (egg, title, sign-ins to the egg, a day bar with a marker per reward) and state-styled cards (claimable green with a pulsing outline, a gold shine on the egg card, BONUS on the rewards after the egg, faded once claimed)
Pad and follower creatures without a name get no tag; named ones keep name, species and rarity
lune run tests/run, selene, stylua, rojo build with check-place, validate-tasks and check-scope pass
verification: Studio play test of the built place: strip icons, both REWARDS tabs
notes: Cause of the icon blobs: UiKit.icon hid its two-letter glyph on IsLoaded's changed signal, which never fires, so every loaded icon kept a white glyph behind it; it now polls IsLoaded for 30 s. The paw button is labelled PETS so every label fits inside 96 px at the 12 px floor on a phone.
evidence: Studio, local build of garden.project.json (build stamp dev): all 17 icon glyphs were visible with IsLoaded true before the fix; after it, the strip shows clean icons. REWARDS WEEKLY and MONTHLY show the new banner and cards. lune 578/578; selene 0/0; stylua clean.
Not checked live: the name-tag change (the dev profile has no creatures; the change is an early return in both tag builders), and phone size.
